payload.summary: Assess remaining calculator mockup components and test dependencies after route retirement
payload.detail:
CURRENT CORRECTION 24 October 2026: calculator mockup routes are already retired and removed (384eb663cd; mockups/README.md lists eight retired routes). Remaining candidates are src/components/calculator-mockups/index.ts and its component/fixture/pathway files, with real test dependencies including calculator-content-fidelity, calculator-completion-and-quarantine, calculator-mockup-clinical-safety and calculator-mockup-boundary. Assess reachability and the normal deletion safeguards before any removal; do not call the whole directory dead. This is distinct from the 13 November hold under #8Y9169. No code/test was deleted.

HISTORICAL DETAIL (superseded where corrected above): #1WAA0Z was archived on 17 Oct after confirming only the On Call Education, Compliance and Logistics screens are live (audit L4D-05). The older calculator mockups under src/app/mockups (calculators-*) from audit M5-2 were not checked. Delete nothing without npm run check:dead-code-candidate (see docs/agents/dead-code-deletion.md).
payload.source: Independent current-source cross-check 24 October 2026 at df1e07db04; mockups/README.md and src/components/calculator-mockups.
